title: Vattenfall Eldistribution NUP §1.2 macro-area profile
description: One record per macro area (5 total: North, Central, Stockholm, East, West). Vattenfall partitions its grid into 5 large areas (vs Ellevio's 17 detailed subareas). These areas carry a qualitative outlook per pillar (local grid, regional grid, transmission relations, production, consumption) but DO NOT enumerate municipalities — that mapping lives in Annex 1 ('Forecast local grid per municipality') and is loaded into a separate schema (vattenfall_municipality_forecast).

macro_area_key.description: Stable snake_case ASCII key, e.g. vattenfall_north, vattenfall_central.

macro_area_name.description: Full name as published in the source (proper noun in original Swedish where applicable, e.g. 'Norrland'; or English translation of descriptive name, e.g. 'Central Sweden (excluding Stockholm)').

regions_or_counties.description: County or region names mentioned as part of this area in §1.1 or §1.2 (qualitative). NOT a definitive municipality list — those come from Annex 1.

specific_locations_mentioned.description: Specific municipalities or geographic features named in the §1.2 narrative (e.g. 'Gotland', 'Askersund municipality', 'west coast'). Useful for anchoring the area but not exhaustive.

voltage_note.description: Free text on voltage upgrade plans (e.g. 220 to 400 kV transmission grid, 70 to 130 kV regional grid).

local_grid_outlook.description: Vattenfall's narrative on local-grid growth, characteristics, and needs in this area.

regional_grid_outlook.description: Vattenfall's narrative on regional-grid needs in this area (capacity, investment, structural changes).

transmission_grid_relations.description: How the area's regional grid relates to Svenska Kraftnät's transmission grid (programs, voltage upgrades, connection points).

production_outlook.description: Production trends and characteristics (wind, hydro, CHP, solar, surplus/deficit patterns, seasonal balance).

consumption_outlook.description: Consumption trends and characteristics (industry, residential, growth drivers).

relevant_transmission_programs.description: Named Svenska Kraftnät / TSO programs affecting this area (e.g. 'NordSyd').

narrative_note.description: Free-text English narrative for context that does not fit the structured fields (risks, dependencies, geographic overlaps with other DSOs, source-published name if it differs from macro_area_name, etc.).
